trigger.description: The inherited H6-M1 scheduler treats every token whose game has not yet started as active once the global earliest pre-arm begins. In the 30-market H6-M2 cohort, registered starts span more than two days, so this would unnecessarily subscribe later markets for many hours before their frozen final-30-minute windows.

operational_change.per_market_activation_rule: A registered token becomes capture-active at its registered game_start_time_utc minus 1800 seconds minus 120 seconds, and remains capture-active strictly until its registered game_start_time_utc.
operational_change.primary_window_rule: registered game_start_time_utc - 1800s <= local raw-frame receive time < registered game_start_time_utc
operational_change.when_no_tokens_are_active: Collector remains armed but makes no market websocket subscription and waits until the next deterministic registered activation boundary.
operational_change.when_active_token_set_changes: End the current connection and reconnect using the complete currently active token set.
operational_change.rest_initialization_on_connection: Perform the frozen full REST initialization for every currently active token after each connection.

rationale.scientific: Only observations inside each frozen final-30-minute primary window are scientifically eligible. Maintaining 120 seconds of deterministic per-market pre-arm is sufficient to initialize causal book state before that window.
rationale.engineering: Avoid unnecessary multi-day raw websocket and normalized capture for markets whose scientific windows have not begun.
rationale.storage: Reduce disk exposure on the collector host while preserving all frozen H6-M2 scientific observations.
